summary: The base current edition of Check Point Harmony Endpoint: one agent for computers and servers with antivirus, EDR, browser protection, sandbox, VPN and threat intelligence.
value: Malware and ransomware are stopped, and encrypted files are restored.
Phishing sites are blocked right in the browser, and files from the internet arrive sanitised.
Anything that gets through is visible in the event record and can be investigated and cleaned up.
simple: Protects computers and servers (Windows, macOS, Linux, VDI) with a single agent, managed from the cloud or on premises. Blocks malware, ransomware (with recovery of encrypted files), exploits, communication between infected machines and attacker servers (Anti-Bot), and fileless attacks by behavior; uses Check Point ThreatCloud threat intelligence and its own indicators of compromise. Automatically collects forensic data and builds an attack report mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and lets you hunt for threats. Includes a host firewall, USB port and device control, application control, a check that the computer complies with policies, and a VPN client for remote access. In the browser, it blocks phishing sites, including brand-new ones (Zero Phishing), filters URLs, turns on safe search and doesn’t let employees enter a corporate password on a third-party site. Checks suspicious downloaded files in a sandbox (Threat Emulation) and immediately hands back a cleaned copy (Threat Extraction). Posture Management, DLP and XDR are purchased separately.
notIncluded: Disk and USB encryption starts with Complete.
Vulnerability management, DLP and SOAR are in Elite (in Advanced only as add-ons).
classification: Forensic collection is DFIR; Threat Cloud + IOC Management is threat intelligence; Firewall + Port Protection is device control.
Application Control and Endpoint Compliance stay in the text; Posture Management, DLP and XDR as add-ons are not counted.
